payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the inference models used to estimate socioeconomic status (SES) from online behavioral data, particularly from Twitter users.

claims.text: The inference models for estimating socioeconomic status rely on three datasets: socioeconomic census data, crawled profession information, and expert annotated Google Street View images of users' home locations.
Gaussian Processes have been applied to predict user income, occupation, and socioeconomic class based on demographic and psycho-linguistic features.
The models utilize user semantics in communication and environmental variables to infer socioeconomic status, indicating a complex relationship between language use and social attributes.
